pinned_defender.description: White rook e4 geometrically defends bishop f4 while absolutely pinned by rook e8.

defended_attacked_piece.description: Bishop g4 attacks knight f3, which pawn g2 geometrically defends.

opening_file.description: b4xc5 removes the last b-file pawn; the c-file still has a white pawn.

pawn_structure.description: White e5 is passed, e3 is not; both e-pawns are doubled and isolated.
